author: APompliano
text:
Army helicopters flew over College Gameday & students started a “USA! USA! USA!” chant.

“If you're not the United States of America and you hear that sound, your ass better run." - Pat McAfee

Greatest country on earth & we ain’t apologizing for it 🇺🇸
